svg.title: Manager links and direct reports — SoftTrack web design mockup (#124)
svg.desc: A site admin sets each person’s manager from Administration → Users. A link that would create a cycle is refused with a sentence. Profiles show the manager and direct reports as links, and the admin directory lists reports whose manager is deactivated.
svg.text: · one nullable link, refused when it would loop
Administration → Users: choosing a manager, and the loop it would make

g.text: Every account on this SoftTrack. Accounts are deactivated rather than deleted:
tickets, comments and history all point at them.
3 people report to a deactivated manager
Chief Operating Officer · Leadership · no manager
Amina can’t report to Daniel Okafor:
Senior Backend Engineer · Engineering · reports to Amina Khan
Refused at write time, with a
Picking yourself is the one-step case:
Deactivating a manager leaves the links alone.
This banner makes the situation findable instead of
something to discover profile by profile.

svg.text: On a profile: manager and direct reports, all links

g.text: Direct reports is the reverse query: everyone

svg.text: “Show them”: reports of a deactivated manager

g.text: IT Administrator · reports to Jonas Berg (deactivated)
Office Manager · reports to Jonas Berg (deactivated)
Data Analyst · reports to Jonas Berg (deactivated)

svg.text: manager_id is a nullable self-referencing FK on the profile, set from the admin user directory alongside department and start date. It is information, not authority: no approvals
and no permissions derive from it. Roles stay team admin/member and the site admin.
